result.topic_en: Hilbert lists properties of systems of forms (closure under addition and subtraction, closure under integral rational functions, divisibility, finite basis), defines a 'full system of forms', and sets out a plan to prove which properties such systems have.

4.) Jede algebr. (überhaupt analytischen) Funktion

5.) Wenn $A\,B$ zum System gehört, so ge-

6.) Es giebt eine endliche Basis, durch welche

ausdrücken lassen.
